subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should core doctor fail closed and skip groupAllowFrom writes when it cannot see a channel plugin schema, or should external plugins get an explicit opt-in migration contract before this bug fix lands?
rationale: The patch fixes a real upgrade regression at the exact write guard, but it intentionally changes released repair behavior for schemaless external channel plugins.

options.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must leave schemaless external channel config untouched instead of writing unverified keys.

options.title: Add External Opt-In Contract
options.body: Pause and add a plugin doctor or schema capability if maintainers want non-bundled channels to opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Proven Broader Protection
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if broader config-protection work lands the same external email/RCS regression behavior and coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must leave schemaless external channel config untouched instead of writing unverified keys.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and merged the fallback migration being repaired, making it the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
